newsitem.title: USA: Truck overturns, explosion threat in North Carolina.
newsitem.headline: Truck overturns, explosion threat in North Carolina.

text.p: Authorities cordoned off a one-mile-square stretch of North Carolina countryside Wednesday after a truck carrying ammonium nitrate, an explosive chemical, overturned on a local highway.
Highway Patrol Lieut. J.E. Smith said the truck overturned between the towns of Princeton and Goldsboro, in the eastern portion of the state at about 7 a.m. EDT (1100 GMT).
He said the truck's cargo would cause a powerful explosion if it were detonated, but that was of little actual risk.
"We do not anticipate an explosion," Smith said.
The sparsely populated area was cordoned off and a stretch of highway was closed for several hours as a precaution, he said.
